subject: [PATCH 58/60] selftests/dax: test memory policy on private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the kmem_private_policy.sh script does not properly handle the case where a memoryless node is present, which can cause the tool to fail when trying to bind a private node.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux kernel's selftest suite to verify the memory policy on private nodes. The test uses the kmem_private_policy_tool to report KTAP results, which include testing for private node binding, memory movement, and reclaiming. The test also checks that exhausting private memory fails with a SIGBUS signal and leaves another task on the node alone. The patch raises the dax selftest timeout to 300 seconds due to the policy test faults in node-sized buffers.
